premise: a street-level heist game of black-market chrome and data runs in a megacity

slots.name: cyber/panel
slots.note: A cyberpunk interface panel, completely opaque and solid everywhere including its centre (no hole, no transparency, no vignette): a flat near-black #0d0e10 ground, its top-left and bottom-right corners cut off at 45°, a crisp 1.5 px acid-yellow (#f5e60c) line along its whole edge that follows the cuts, and one short thicker yellow tab along the top-left cut. No glow, no scanlines, no magenta, no rivets or circuit marks. As the panels of the concept's settings and shop. Everything outside its cut corners is fully transparent. The cut corners are hard straight 45° diagonals, about one sixth of the piece's height (about 16 px at this size): crisp, never rounded or bevelled softly; every other corner is a perfectly square 90° corner with radius 0. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cyber/card
slots.note: A shop item card, one of many repeated side by side: a near-black #121316 rectangle with its top-left corner cut off at 45°, a 1 px neutral dim grey (#3a3b3f) edge line that follows the cut, the same grey all round; no yellow, cyan or any other colour anywhere, and no marks, dots or brackets in its corners (yellow marks only the selected card, which the game draws itself). Completely plain otherwise: no tags, text, icons, glow or ornaments. Everything outside its cut corner is fully transparent. The cut corners are hard straight 45° diagonals, about one sixth of the piece's height (about 16 px at this size): crisp, never rounded or bevelled softly; every other corner is a perfectly square 90° corner with radius 0. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: cyber/field
slots.note: A completely plain input box: a solid near-black #0c0d0f rectangle with a single uniform 1 px mid-grey (#4a4b50) outline of the same weight and colour on all four sides, square 90° corners. Absolutely nothing else: no yellow, no brackets, no corner accents, no ticks, no dots, no tab, no text. The four corners look exactly like each other and like any point of the edges. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch).

No ornament, glow or text. Everything outside its cut corner is fully transparent. The cut corners are hard straight 45° diagonals, about one sixth of the piece's height (about 16 px at this size): crisp, never rounded or bevelled softly; every other corner is a perfectly square 90° corner with radius 0. slots.name: cyber/button
slots.note: A secondary button in its states: a near-black (#0d0e10) rectangle with its top-left and bottom-right corners cut off at 45° and a 1.5 px acid-yellow (#f5e60c) edge line following the cuts; the label area flat near-black so light text reads on it. Hovered: the edge brighter and the ground one step lighter. No dots, rivets or marks inside its corners. As the Back and Reset to Default keys of the concept. Everything outside its cut corners is fully transparent. The cut corners are hard straight 45° diagonals, about one sixth of the piece's height (about 16 px at this size): crisp, never rounded or bevelled softly; every other corner is a perfectly square 90° corner with radius 0. The cut ends are plain too, so it reads cleanly when short.

slots.name: cyber/button-primary
slots.note: The primary button in its states: a solid flat acid-yellow (#f5e60c) slab filling the whole piece from top to bottom, its top-left and bottom-right corners cut off at 45°, with a thin darker yellow (#c9bc00) edge; the label area flat yellow so black text reads on it. No gradient, glow, sheen, dots or marks inside its corners. As the BUY & FIT button of the concept. Everything outside its cut corners is fully transparent. The cut corners are hard straight 45° diagonals, about one sixth of the piece's height (about 16 px at this size): crisp, never rounded or bevelled softly; every other corner is a perfectly square 90° corner with radius 0. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge. No arrow, chevron or text on it.

slots.name: cyber/corner
slots.note: A small corner mark: a short acid-yellow (#f5e60c) right-angle bracket, two 2 px strokes about 10 px long meeting at the top-left, on a clear background. As the corner ticks on the concept's settings frame. Nothing else.

slots.name: cyber/divider
slots.note: A horizontal divider: one plain 1 px dim grey (#3a3b3f) line of even weight from end to end, on a clear background. Nothing else: no tick, dot, diamond, segment or colour anywhere on it.

slots.name: cyber/flourish
slots.note: A heading accent: three small acid-yellow (#f5e60c) forward slashes in a row (like '///'), each about 2 px thick, on a clear background. Small and flat, no glow.

slots.name: cyber/thumb
slots.note: A slider's thumb: one narrow upright bar centred in a square image, as tall as the image and about a third as wide (8 of 24), solid acid yellow (#f5e60c) with a crisp 1 px near-black (#0a0a0c) edge all round, square corners, flat, no glow. Fully transparent to the bar's left and right. Nothing else: no track.

slots.name: cyber/knob
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch, not the switch: one small solid acid-yellow (#f5e60c) square, as tall as it is wide, with a 1 px black edge, flat, no glow. No track, no capsule, no second shape: a single yellow square filling the image.

slots.name: cyber/knob-off
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch, not the switch: one small solid mid-grey (#6b6c70) square, as tall as it is wide, with a 1 px black edge, flat. No track, no capsule, no second shape: a single grey square filling the image.
